description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Everpure is hiring a Software Engineer Grad to help build data storage and management software. The role contributes to product development, solves data-efficiency challenges, improves performance and scalability, and collaborates with engineering and cross-functional teams.
Graduate Software Engineer developing core software products, optimizing data deduplication and reclamation, and improving wide-area replication.

Responsibilities:
• Contribute to core product development: Take ownership of key tasks within the software development lifecycle, from ideation and design to implementation and testing
• Innovate and solve complex problems: Research and develop solutions for challenges related to data efficiency, such as optimizing data deduplication and reclamation, or improving replication across wide-area networks
• Enhance system performance and scalability: Work on projects that improve the performance of our software, ensuring it scales effectively with ever-increasing data volumes and hardware capabilities
• Collaborate across teams: Partner with senior engineers and cross-functional teams to integrate new features and maintain a high standard of code quality through extensive automated testing

Requirements:
• A solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and design principles
• You're comfortable writing clean, efficient, and well-structured code in C++
• A proactive and self-motivated approach to identifying and solving complex problems with a focus on delivering high-quality, impactful results
• The ability to articulate complex technical ideas clearly and work effectively in a team-based, open office environment
